what: Photos sit in shape-hole masks (triangle, diamond, arch, stairs) and at rest are large enough to cover the cell (triangle 3.4 · diamond 2.1 · arch 3 · stairs 4.6×). On hover they shrink in .4s cubic-bezier(.87,0,.13,1) to a .9× hole (stairs 1.2×), revealing a black border while the photo recedes 1.1 → 1×. Outside the hole you see the cell background color and the name marquee above it, which flows only while hovered.

options.--fx-rest / --fx-hover: Shape scale at rest·on hover (css variable) — default 3 · .9. Each shape needs a different scale to cover the cell: triangle 3.4 · diamond 2.1 · arch 3 · stairs 4.6 (stairs hover 1.2)
options.[data-fx-part=shape]: Inner mask shape path and border path (same d) — both change with scale
options.[data-fx-part=marquee]: Flowing line visible outside the hole (flows only when a hand is present)

use: …

from.where: shared.css event card .rb-tease · eat and drink tile .rb-tile (index·events)

note: The mask is mask-type: alpha so the shape color is unrelated to the skin. If the shape path is drawn on a 400 grid (0~400), the original four shapes can be used as they are
